rows.title: Flowchart skips the analyst approval step
rows.reason: Alerts go from scoring to action with no analyst sign-off drawn.

rows.title: Success measure missing from the scope
rows.reason: The PRD lists features but no number that says the use case worked.

rows.title: Mockup is desktop only and has no owner view
rows.reason: The reviewer works from a phone between meetings. Show a small-screen layout and the owner's own list.

rows.title: Flowchart does not show who approves exceptions
rows.reason: Invoices that do not match need an approver. The flowchart ends at the match step.

rows.title: Flowchart skips the scan approval step
rows.reason: The flowchart goes from ranking straight to raising tickets. The scope says the manager approves the scan first, so that step must be drawn.

rows.title: Success measure missing from the scope
rows.reason: No target for match rate or time saved.

rows.title: Mockup has no owner view
rows.reason: The mockup only shows the analyst's triage table. Asset owners need a view of their own items with accept and dispute.
